newsitem.title: USA: Ind. housing finance wants disclosures on web site.
newsitem.headline: Ind. housing finance wants disclosures on web site.

text.p: Indiana Housing Finance Authority Executive Director Robert Welch Jr. said Friday he would like to place updated disclosures on bond issuances on the authority's web site before the end of the year.
Welch said the authority is also considering obtaining a second rating to satisfy some portfolio managers who are required to invest in debt that has dual ratings.
The authority has obtained a rating from Moody's Investors Service and is considering adding a rating from Standard & Poor's or Fitch Investers Service, Welch said.
The authority tries to disclose what investors need, not just meet the minimum requirements, Welch said at the John Nuveen & Co state housing agency/investor conference in Chicago.
Indiana also hopes to post official statements for bond issuances on the web site at HTTP://www.ai.org/IHFA, Welch said.
